name: Dolphin PR #14821: MMU: Fix non-integral HostTryRead not passing space + Custom Storage Location
body:
Built from custom release-sync branch, merged with the custom user data storage location feature (Scoped Storage / Internal Storage / SD Card) and Games on Wii Menu Patch.

Built from upstream Dolphin PR `#14821`.

### Upstream Dolphin PR [#14821](https://github.com/dolphin-emu/dolphin/pull/14821)
**Title:** MMU: Fix non-integral HostTryRead not passing space
**Author:** [@SuperSamus](https://github.com/SuperSamus)

#### PR Description
Randomly spotted. Didn't test, but it was obviously wrong. Fixes regression from 8a97ce9124c94f868b078d67208f81795f259323.

Also, since I spotted it with clang-tidy, I also fixed the pointless consts in MMU.h that it was [complaining about](https://clang.llvm.org/extra/clang-tidy/checks/readability/avoid-const-params-in-decls.html).

This is an unofficial community build, not affiliated with the Dolphin team.

name: Dolphin PR #14733: DolReader: Don't error on dol section alignment on Wii + Custom Storage Location
body:
Built from custom release-sync branch, merged with the custom user data storage location feature (Scoped Storage / Internal Storage / SD Card) and Games on Wii Menu Patch.

Built from upstream Dolphin PR `#14733`.

### Upstream Dolphin PR [#14733](https://github.com/dolphin-emu/dolphin/pull/14733)
**Title:** DolReader: Don't error on dol section alignment on Wii
**Author:** [@DacoTaco](https://github.com/DacoTaco)

#### PR Description
in #14651 i was too strict.
IOS does not flat out reject out of alignment sections, but apploaders (disk/gamecube/..) do.
ive changed the error message to mention that, and ive made it into a warning for wii and error for gamecube.

this should make older priiloaders (and a few other homebrew) in System menu bootable again :)

This is an unofficial community build, not affiliated with the Dolphin team.

name: Dolphin PR #14259: GameINI: Add Disable Blur code for Pikmin 1 Wii + Custom Storage Location
body:
Built from custom release-sync branch, merged with the custom user data storage location feature (Scoped Storage / Internal Storage / SD Card) and Games on Wii Menu Patch.

Built from upstream Dolphin PR `#14259`.

### Upstream Dolphin PR [#14259](https://github.com/dolphin-emu/dolphin/pull/14259)
**Title:** GameINI: Add Disable Blur code for Pikmin 1 Wii
**Author:** [@Reonu](https://github.com/Reonu)

#### PR Description
Adds Gecko codes by Minty Meeo to disable the very annoying "Motion Blur" effect from the Wii version of Pikmin 1, for all regions. A similar code is already built into Dolphin for the GameCube versions, but there weren't any codes for the Wii version until now.

This is an unofficial community build, not affiliated with the Dolphin team.

# Packages

## Targets

Each build is optimized for a specific architecture and uses a specific compiler.

- **arm64-v8a**: For devices that use the armv8-a instruction set; e.g. Snapdragon X, all Android devices, and Apple Silicon Macs.
- **x86_64**: For devices that use the x86_64 instruction set; this is exclusively used by Intel and AMD CPUs and is only found on desktops.
- **v3**: For devices that use the x86_64-v3 instruction set or newer; this is found on Ryzen, Intel 4th Generation (Haswell), and newer.

### PGO

PGO builds usually perform ~10-30% better than standard builds, and are thus generally recommended for all users.

## Linux

Pretty much self explanatory, own implementation based on LSFG-VK available with some additional reverse engineer work for the actual use of shaders inside Lossless.dll, we don't store/ bundle any tools that bypass security and self ownership: to use this feature is required to own your own copy of Lossless Scaling and I encourage to support developers behind this work.

2.- PancakeTAS - Developer behind LSFG-VK
3.- The Big Smolio The Sleeper (@gidoly)

Shotgun attempt to fix fullscreen issue on samsung dex. 

External test mapping:
bit 1, value 2: disable runtime fullscreen attempts
bit 2, value 4: force runtime user-landscape
bit 3, value 8: add legacy sticky system UI flags
bit 4, value 16: add delayed retries
bit 5, value 32: runtime orientation unspecified
bit 6, value 64: add FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS
Good smoke masks: 0, 8, 16, 24, 4, 12, 20, 28, 32, 40, 64, 72, 88, 2.


EDIT: 8 (bit 3) did the trick. All cleaned up.

# Packages

## Targets

Each build is optimized for a specific architecture and uses a specific compiler.

- **arm64-v8a**: For devices that use the armv8-a instruction set; e.g. Snapdragon X, all Android devices, and Apple Silicon Macs.
- **x86_64**: For devices that use the x86_64 instruction set; this is exclusively used by Intel and AMD CPUs and is only found on desktops.
- **v3**: For devices that use the x86_64-v3 instruction set or newer; this is found on Ryzen, Intel 4th Generation (Haswell), and newer.

### PGO

PGO builds usually perform ~10-30% better than standard builds, and are thus generally recommended for all users.

## Linux
